title: Individual-specific subspace of altered functional connectivity predicts clinical symptoms in Internet gaming disorder.
authors: Li S, Jiang A, Wang M, Ni H, Fu J, Dong G.

The brain networks associated with four common components in the individual-shared subspace.  (A) Common component 1 was linked to the MFN, FPN, LN, VN-I, and VN-II. (B) Common component 2 was associated with the FPN, MN, VN-I, VN-II, and Ce. (C) Common component 3 corresponded to the MFN, DMN, MN, and VAN. (D) Common component 4 was associated with the FPN, DMN, VN-I, VN-II, and BGN

Relationships between AFC in the individual-specific subspace and clinical symptoms.  (A) FAFC within DMN showed a negative association with BAS-Fun Seeking scores. (B) FAFC within MFN showed negative associations with BAS-Reward Responsiveness scores. (C) FAFC within MFN was negatively associated with BAS-Drive scores. (D) FAFC within FPN exhibited a negative association with BIS scores

Predicting clinical symptoms using AFC in the individual-specific subspace.  (A) FAFC within the DMN could predict BAS- Fun Seeking scores.
